relationships.subject: SAHA
relationships.evidence_quote: Intranasal administration of i-BET762 (BET inhibitor) or SAHA (HDAC inhibitor) attenuated thermal and mechanical hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: i-BET762
relationships.evidence_quote: Spinal cord sections of SNI mice showed an increased expression of HDAC1 and Brd4 proteins and combination produced a stronger reduction compared to each epigenetic agent alone

relationships.subject: SAHA
relationships.evidence_quote: SAHA and i-BET762, administered alone or in combination, counteracted the SNI-induced microglia activation

relationships.subject: SAHA
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB) and signal transducer and activator of transcription-1 (STAT1) with comparable efficacy

key_findings: HDAC inhibitor SAHA and BET inhibitor i-BET762 each attenuate SNI hypersensitivity and combination is stronger.
SNI increases spinal HDAC1 and Brd4; inhibitors reduce microglial activation, NF-κB and STAT1.
